precepts.text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help and trust in chariots but look not to the Holy One of Israel: all Egypt's power did not save it, he will not call back his word, and evil is set for all these nations while you sit in confederacy with them thinking all nations are saved.
precepts.point: The Most High loves his people, and as the wars come, hard times are coming for the twelve tribes.

note.label: The God Of War & Salvation

precepts.why:
The Lord is a man of war, and his vengeance is on all the nations read in Psalms 83; he has a big payback coming for all of them. Egypt is one example. Exodus 15 says “Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea”, and Isaiah 31 shows what all that power was worth: “Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong”.

Did the power help them? No. All their chariots and all their war materials did not help them at all. And “they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!” We did not look to the Holy One of Israel, to our God, to save us. The God of Israel is the only God that is going to save us out of all this foolishness. The wars are going to come to the point where thermonuclear ICBMs are put in full effect and a lot of people die, and the question to ask yourself is, will it be us?

“Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words”. He is not calling back his word. Evil is set for all these nations, and these nations will be destroyed. Where will you be? You cannot have God to trust in and Christ coming to save you while you sit in confederacy with all these nations, thinking all nations are going to be saved and we are all together. That is not the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

So the right hand that “hath dashed in pieces the enemy” in Exodus 15:6 is the same hand that will overthrow every nation Israel trusts in instead of him.

precepts.point: Habakkuk 3:16, the prophet's belly trembled because he was put in it, and when he cometh up unto the people he will invade them with his troops. Isaiah 31:4, like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, the Lion of the tribe of Judah of Revelation 5:5, so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion; as birds flying, Christ and the angels, he will defend Jerusalem, and passing over he will preserve it. Jeremiah 4:7, the lion is come up from his thicket, the destroyer of the Gentiles, Nebuchadnezzar contextually and Christ prophetically. 2 Esdras 11:37, a roaring lion chased out of the wood sends a man's voice unto the eagle, America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
“For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey”. What is this talking about? The Lion of the tribe of Judah in Revelation 5:5: Christ.

And “when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.” The Lord is going to fight for his people.

“As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem”. As birds flying is Christ and the angels. And “defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.” Passing over: this is the Passover season, and just as he passed over us in Egypt, he will pass over and preserve his people.

That is what it means that his eyes are upon them that love him and he is their mighty protection. He comes down as a roaring lion to fight for mount Zion and defend Jerusalem.

note.label: War of the Gods

precepts.why:
“Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit.” That is the war of gods. On one side is the god still sitting in our minds, the image of white supremacy that was forced into our spirits; on the other side is the God of this Bible. The Egyptians set themselves up as gods, but they are only men, and all their weaponry is flesh.

Their weapons are not only for warring with other people. They are there to force a thought into our minds, to force white supremacy into our spirits. So the war is first in the mind, and the ignorance of our people is the battlefield.

“When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.” That is what Isaiah 19 shows: the Lord sets “the Egyptians against the Egyptians”, “city against city, and kingdom against kingdom”, and “the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof.” There is going to be civil war, and there will be wars from outside as well.

And when it comes, “they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.” They will cry out to the images they revered as gods, talking to those Jesus pieces, asking them to come save them. They will run back to the news outlets that lied for years, to Christianity, to every version of white supremacy. But men are not God, and none of it will hold them up.

So the Lord is teaching us war tactics, because there are going to be wars in the flesh. We have to keep strong in the war we already have in our spirit, knowing the ones who made themselves gods over us are only flesh.

note.label: Psalm 9: I Will Praise the Lord With My Whole Heart

precepts.why:
David prays, “Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men.” The nations have reigned so long that in their minds they think they are God. Isaiah gives the same reminder: “Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!”

Woe to them that go down to Egypt, America, for help. “Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.” The Egyptians are men and not God, and when the Lord stretches out his hand both helper and helped shall fall.

That is David's prayer: that the Lord remind them they are nothing but men. The only reason they could do what they did to us is that we broke God's laws. But “the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever”, and the Lord “will arise against the house of the evildoers”.

note.label: Isaiah 31: Egypt Is Flesh, Not Spirit

precepts.why:
Here is the going down to Egypt for help in the history. It was “in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.” His servant Rabshakeh mocked the trust in Egypt: “Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.”

Then he dangled the gift: “Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.” Two thousand horses to stay on, the very horses and chariots Isaiah 31 says woe to. It was the same trick, a gift to pull the heart off the Most High. We honor him with our lips, but when the oppressor offers gifts we turn away and serve our oppressor’s will, instead of looking to the Holy One of Israel.

note.label: Passover: a Celebration of Deliverance From Oppression

precepts.why:
The precept for the ensign. Isaiah explained the ensign in verse 5, as birds flying, but Isaiah 11 makes it more crystal clear. “And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse”: the root of Jesse is Jesus the Christ, “which shall stand for an ensign”. Ensign means symbol: “an ensign of the people”. Christ is that ensign of the people. Right now we have his word, his Bible, but soon to come he’s coming as God; soon to come he’s coming as birds flying.

“To it shall the Gentiles seek”: those Gentiles that seek unto the Lord are us. We are the Gentiles because we were raised as Gentiles: African-Americans, Puerto Ricans, Jamaicans, Haitians, Brazilians, Suriname, Belize, Panamanians, Mexicans. Those are Gentile names, Gentile nationalities; we are those Gentiles, and now we’re seeking to the Lord, to the God of Israel. “And his rest shall be glorious”: God’s rest shall be glorious.

So when Isaiah 31 says his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, it is Christ returning as birds flying that they shall fear.

note.label: Passover: a Celebration of Deliverance From Oppression

precepts.why:
Go back to Isaiah 11 and 10 one more time; there was some good stuff in there. Newly appointed soldiers, here’s an easy precept to go to on the street, a good precept to explain who the Gentiles are that receive salvation: “to it shall the Gentiles seek”.

“And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria”: write this down, Assyria is Turkey. “And from Egypt”: that’s Lower Egypt. “And from Pathros”: that’s Upper Egypt, that’s the Sudan. “And from Cush”: that’s Ethiopia. “And from Elam”: that’s Iran and India. “And from Shinar”: that’s Iraq. “And from Hamath”: that’s Syria. “And from the islands of the sea”: that’s the Caribbean, Cape Verde, Hawaiian, Philippines. Look them up when you get a chance: Afro-Turkey, Afro-Iranians, Afro-Iraqis. Our people are there.

“And he shall set up an ensign for the nations”: the ensign for the nations is Christ, but we know Christ ain’t here yet, so until then we have his word. This is the word of God; this is the ensign we hold. “And shall assemble the outcasts of Israel”: the Gentiles the Bible speaks of are the outcasts of Israel. “And gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth”: so the Gentiles we read about are the dispersed of Judah.

precepts.why: Often you hear or read about Christian commentaries that reference Isaiah prophesying, and their commentaries are stuck in time, as if what happened when Assyria came ended there, as if those curses stopped. So what happened in ancient Egypt happened in Assyria; what happened in Assyria happened in Babylon; what happened in Babylon happened in Persia and Media; what happened in Persia and Media happened in the Greek captivity; what happened in the Greek captivity happened in the Roman captivity; what happened in the Roman captivity happened in the Spanish captivity, French captivity, European captivity, American captivity. points: “Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword”: just as God compares America with Egypt, he compares America with Assyria; he compares the Europeans, the Caucasians, with Assyria. “Not of a mighty man”: this place won’t fall by a mighty man, “and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited”: all America’s military shall be discomfited by the Lord’s military.

note.label: Passover: a Celebration of Deliverance From Oppression

points: “And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear”: America is going to run back to their strongholds. They got over 300 strongholds worldwide, and they’re going to pass over to their strongholds for fear. “And his princes shall be afraid of the ensign”: the military leaders of America shall fear when Christ returns; Space Force shall fear when the Son of God comes. “Saith the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.”

note.label: Passover: a Celebration of Deliverance From Oppression

points: “Turn ye unto him”: that is what we must do, turn to God. “From whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.” Deeply. We see the depths of our revolt in how much we love the other nations. Examine the state of blacks and Hispanics today: we are lawless and degenerate, taught to hate everything about ourselves and to love and embrace everything this system has set up for us. It all stems from not wanting to keep and apply the commandments God has given us.
